title: Acceptance probability after preprocessing
statement: Let $T$ be a sign tester, let $\delta\in[0,1]$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube taking values in $[-1,1]$. The acceptance probability of the tester formed by preprocessing $T$ with independent query noise of correlation $1-\delta$ equals the noise-preprocessed acceptance probability of $T$ on $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a sign tester on the $n$-dimensional sign cube with finite seed space
